name: checkout-test-mcp
description: Run checkout and payment test scenarios on your test shop. Get a clear result for each run.
long_description: Lets Claude run end-to-end checkout and payment test scenarios against test shops that you list in a config file. The server only opens hosts on your allow list and only uses published test cards. It starts a real browser, runs the scenario, and returns a structured result. The server needs Google Chrome or Playwright Chromium on your computer. Run npx checkout-test-mcp init to install Chromium.

config_path.title: Config file
config_path.description: The checkout-test-mcp YAML config file. It lists your test targets and the hosts that are allowed.

env_file.title: Env file (optional)
env_file.description: A .env file with the secrets that your config uses. Leave this empty if you do not use secrets.
